pages.description: Every printed page visible in the image, left to right (a scan may hold a two-page spread).

number.description: The printed page number, or null.

lesson.description: The lesson label in the running header or footer, as printed ("LES 2", "3"), or null.

lessonStarts.description: A lesson whose opening (number and title) is printed in this image.

blocks.description: The target-language content, in reading order. Everything else on the page is left out.

kind.description: dialogue: speakers taking turns, or one speaker's numbered passage. sentences: standalone target-language sentences or phrases (grammar examples, captions, phrase boxes, exercise questions). words: a vocabulary list.

lesson.description: The lesson this block belongs to, as labelled on its page, or null.

heading.description: The block's heading as printed, or null.

number.description: The block's number as printed ("2", "3A"), or null.

continues.description: True when this block is the continuation of one cut off at the end of the previous page.

lines.description: For dialogue and sentences: one entry per spoken turn or sentence. Empty for words.

speaker.description: The speaker's name or label as printed ("A", "Els", "Peter en Els"); null when the line continues the previous speaker or has none.

reading.description: A printed pronunciation guide for this line (pinyin, furigana), or null.

translation.description: A printed translation of this line, or null.

words.description: For words: one entry per listed word. Empty otherwise.

term.description: The headword as a learner would file it: without a leading article, without conjugations.

notes.description: Printed notes on the word: article, part of speech, conjugated forms ("de", "v.", "ik kom, je komt, hij komt"), or null.

reading.description: A printed pronunciation guide, or null.

meaning.description: A printed meaning or translation, or null when the list gives none.

proper.description: True for a proper noun (a name, a place).
